lines.zh: 我按佣兵的步法走，不快不慢。
lines.en: I walk at a mercenary's pace.

lines.zh: 我的装甲上有旧战场的刮痕。
lines.en: My armor bears old battlefield scars.
I checked the route first.

lines.zh: 我从掩体走到下一个掩体。
lines.en: I move from cover to cover.

lines.zh: 我的脚步压着地面，很稳。
lines.en: My steps press the ground, steady.
My chainblade never stops sounding.
I avoid the open ground ahead.
I hug the wall with my shoulder.
I compute trajectories as I walk.
I've read this terrain.

lines.zh: 我蹲下来，检查我的弹药。
lines.en: I crouch and check my ammunition.

lines.zh: 弹药箱里，只剩三发穿甲弹。
lines.en: Three armor-piercing rounds left in the crate.

lines.zh: 我的面罩上有一道划痕。
lines.en: There's a scar across my visor.
I hone my blade on my thigh.
I've taken this job.
I know the smell of a battlefield.
I wait for the employer's signal.
I crack the knuckles of my left hand.

lines.zh: 我记得每一个倒下的敌人。
lines.en: I remember each foe that fell.
My engine is quiet.
This ground is good for an ambush.
I knock the dirt off my helmet.
No enemies, so I clean my gun.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地呼出一口热气。
lines.en: I let out a slow breath of hot air.
My insignia is still on my chest.
Wind from the east. Noted.
Are you my target?
I quote a price, then fight.
You stand like a rookie.
My visor shows your reflection.
Would you hire me, or kill me?

lines.zh: 我看过太多你这样的人。
lines.en: I've seen too many like you.

lines.zh: 把武器放下，我少打一炮。
lines.en: Lower the weapon, and I fire one less shell.

lines.zh: 我把武器收起来，只是暂时。
lines.en: I put my weapon down. Temporarily.
Someone paid for this job.
Anything left to say?
I've got your outline.
Don't stand in my firing line.
A dent. Still serviceable.
A crack runs across my visor.
A joint stuck, then turned.
I fall back behind cover.

lines.zh: 装甲板歪了，液压声变调。
lines.en: An armor plate is bent; my hydraulics change pitch.
I check the ammo. Still there.
Something's loose inside.
I re-aim, and my hand shakes.
You hit harder than the price suggested.
I can still fight. Don't celebrate.
That money is negotiable.
You put the weapon down. Good.

lines.zh: 多一点定金，我多留一会儿。
lines.en: More up front and I stay longer.
That gear is worth a trip.

lines.zh: 我不为食物动心，为报酬。
lines.en: Food doesn't move me. Payment does.
I lower the muzzle a fraction.

lines.zh: 你说话的方式，我听得进。
lines.en: I can listen to how you talk.
The risk means a higher price.
I move my hand off the trigger.
Not bad terms. I'll consider them.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，我的装甲没动。
lines.en: You hit me and my plate doesn't move.
I bar your path with my arm.
I turn aside with care.
Don't shove a mercenary; it costs more.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，你看了一眼我的徽记。
lines.en: We collide, and you glimpse my insignia.

lines.zh: 我的肩甲擦过你的护腕。
lines.en: My pauldron scrapes your bracer.
I step back to keep distance.
That contact changed my position.
Standing that close is dangerous.
I steady you. That one's free.

lines.zh: 另一个佣兵坐到了对面。
lines.en: Another mercenary sits down opposite.

lines.zh: 我们交换了各自的价格。
lines.en: We trade our rates.
Its gun is newer than mine.
We split the watch over this ground.
Its contract clashes with mine.
We put our backs together.

lines.zh: 它少了一只眼，还是能用。
lines.en: It's missing an eye and still works.
We count the same explosion.
In this trade, partners are rare.
When the job ends, we part.

lines.zh: 我把弹壳捡起来，取回弹药。
lines.en: I pick up the casing and salvage the round.
This part is worth something.
I drop it into my belt pouch.
I pick up an enemy's insignia.

lines.zh: 这块装甲，我留着当补丁。
lines.en: I'll keep this plate for a patch.
The spoils are mine. That's the rule.
I pick it up and check its condition.
This buys a meal.
I tuck it behind my belt.
Heavy enough. Good.
Job accepted. You're the target.
Nothing personal.
I raise the gun to my shoulder line.
I've read your movement.

lines.zh: 这片废土上，只剩你和我。
lines.en: On this wasteland, only you and I are left.
I'll give you three seconds.
My blade is already out.
Run, and I'll follow.
I snap my visor down.
This is work, not a feud.
Beat me to earn the Legendary Mercenary title.

lines.zh: 击杀记录上，又要添你一行。
lines.en: One more line on my kill record, then.

lines.zh: 锁定音一响，你就进名单了。
lines.en: The lock tone sounds; you are on the list.
Stepping back won't avoid this.
Someone else paid.
My warm-up is done; and yours?

lines.zh: 保险栓一开，你就听见了。
lines.en: Safety off. You heard it.
Your position is bad.
I'll ask once more. Are you sure?
Final offer. No haggling.
I take the high ground.

lines.zh: 你往左，我的准星也跟着。
lines.en: You go left; my sights follow.
I'm counting your magazine.

lines.zh: 你不换位置，我也不用动。
lines.en: Stay put and I needn't move.
My breath aligns with the trigger.
You picked the wrong cover.

lines.zh: 掩体后面，你的鞋尖露出来了。
lines.en: Behind the cover, your boot tip shows.
This shot is for your legs.
I adjust the angle half a degree.

lines.zh: 风对弹道的影响我算过。
lines.en: I've accounted for the wind.
Your stance is awkward.
I change firing position.
You won't reach ten.
I'm listening to your steps change.

lines.zh: 这里每一处死角我都知道。
lines.en: I know every blind spot here.

lines.zh: 肩甲和胸甲之间，两指宽。
lines.en: Two fingers wide, between your pauldron and chestplate.
My blade is longer than you think.
I angle my helmet.
You have one last chance.
The instant before I squeeze.

lines.zh: 我一刀劈在你的护肩上。
lines.en: My blade bites your pauldron.
That was a drilled angle.

lines.zh: 我的膝盖顶进你的腹部。
lines.en: My knee drives into your gut.
You pull back; I don't chase far.
My stock cracks your cheek.
These iron joints aren't overheated yet.
I pin you to the ground.

lines.zh: 拳头的冲击把你震退两步。
lines.en: The punch's shock throws you back two steps.

lines.zh: 你听见链锯的声音了吗。
lines.en: Do you hear the chainblade?
I sheathe the blade and step back.
Your arm won't come up now.
I'll leave you alive.
You're gasping on the ground.
This contract is done.

lines.zh: 我从前线的烟里走出来。
lines.en: I walk out of the front-line smoke.

lines.zh: 有人把我的徽记激活了。
lines.en: Someone activated my insignia.

lines.zh: 我先发动，引擎吼了三声。
lines.en: I start up; the engine roars three times.
My plates lock on piece by piece.
This place needs someone who can fight.
I put on my helmet and lock it.
My gun is already chambered.
I drop from the carrier.
On landing I look for cover at once.

lines.zh: 这一带的地图我记住了。
lines.en: I've memorized this area's map.

lines.zh: 我把刀在臂甲上蹭了蹭。
lines.en: I wipe my blade on my vambrace.
The insignia lights. I'm online.
I check who's come.
Payment's in. I start work.

lines.zh: 脚从泥里拔出来，沉得很。
lines.en: Pulling my feet from the mud — heavy.
When I settle, the area goes quiet.

lines.zh: 我的面罩因寒气起了雾。
lines.en: Cold fogs my visor.
This isn't a drill.

lines.zh: 我把弹匣按进去，咔一声。
lines.en: I seat the magazine with a click.
Work's come. I do the work.
Fire sears my armor and leaves scorch.
My leg failed on landing.

lines.zh: 水进了进气口，我咳了一声。
lines.en: Water's in my intake and I choke.
The blast rolls me twice.

lines.zh: 一枚弹嵌进了我的胸甲。
lines.en: A round lodges in my chest plate.

lines.zh: 法术让我的瞄准器失灵。
lines.en: That spell kills my targeting.

lines.zh: 电量低，我的动作变慢了。
lines.en: Power's low; my movements slow.

lines.zh: 雷击让我的电路跳了一下。
lines.en: Lightning makes my circuits jump.

lines.zh: 虚空把我往下拽，我抓着边缘。
lines.en: The void pulls and I grip the edge.
